observations: The page number «XV» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «III*» on the right.

L04-L15: the table of N, set within a ruled frame of two columns, a double rule on the left and the right and a single rule between the columns; the month names in italics in the first column, and in the second, for the number of the days, which the table does not give, a row of nine dots in each row, about 20 px apart, transcribed as dots separated by spaces. Each row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|».

L25: «fol. 9{sub:r}»: the r is printed below the line, where L17 and L36 print the r and v of the folios raised; transcribed as printed. L23: the dash of «302—307» is printed in two pieces, as on p. XI (JP2 0015, L31); transcribed as one long dash. L29-L30: the radix in years, months and days, «9a11m9d» and «9a11m4d», the a, m and d raised; the figures are set without spaces (the gaps between them, 10-13 px, are those between the two figures of «11»).
Marks not transcribed: a dark mark on the k of «hinzukommenden» (L24) and one on the k of «kommt» (L25), in the ink of the print; a light speck at the right of the head of «Radix» (L29).

L25-L28: «Anni iazdeiardi (Yezdegirdi) post aeram arabum», the years of Yazdegerd after the Arab era; the radix that al-Battānī's column gives, 9 years 11 months 9 days, differs from that of N's column, and table 1 has the wrong radix 9 years 11 months 4 days.
